theme: The last day on dry land before Croatia.
greeting: It's Labor Day and the calendar is wide open, Dan — but this is your last full day with signal before twelve days in the Adriatic. The girls are with you and Mike today; tomorrow they go to Jen and you fly out at 5:55.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags before the counter
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's site, confirm the allowance there, and buy bags online today — the fix is cheap now and expensive at the airport, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat night and the landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two bookings are still open and both have to be made from land: the Sept 19 post-charter night in Cavtat, and the St Pete room for Sept 20-21 before the kids' Tuesday pickup. Charter connectivity dies once you're aboard.

needsAttention.title: Call the car-rental hedge
needsAttention.detail: The task's own decision point is today. Book a refundable Full Size SUV for Sept 20 - Oct 5 unless Mike's car has a written delivery window into Florida — otherwise you're finding a walk-up rental jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Settle Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: This was due Sept 5 and the Oct 18 rotation booking fires while you're at sea. One call decides three downstream items, and it shouldn't be made from a boat — close it before you fly.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Andrew Kaufmann's reconnect
needsAttention.detail: He messaged on LinkedIn to reconnect and asks whether you're still at KPMG — a warm networking thread from someone you last spoke to in December. A short reply today beats going quiet for two weeks.

flagged.title: OCHIN SVP, State Affairs posted
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert for a senior state-affairs executive role — squarely in your public-affairs lane if you want a look before you go dark.

flagged.title: Dubrovnik host is waiting on you
flagged.detail: Damjan, your Sept 9-12 Old Port host, replied again today with a question — worth closing before the flight.

inbox.noise: The usual Labor Day promos — Pottery Barn rewards, a couple of retail discounts, and some overseas spam.

recipe.title: Quinces Poached in Muscat
recipe.why: Quinces come into season in early autumn, and a slow poach in sweet wine turns their hard flesh silky and amber.

tasks.title: Contact the Nautilus instructor — confirm boarding and the return transfer
Watch the rest of the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: A clear Labor Day morning — no meetings and no handoff yet, the calendar entirely yours.
The day tilts into packing and loose ends, everything that has to be settled from dry land before the boat takes your signal.
A last night with all four girls in the St Pete house before tomorrow's handoff and the flight to Frankfurt.
